our_interpretation: The context identifies the Harris–Trump presidential debate on 2024-09-10.
Saying little permits an incidental reference. Substantial discussion would explain an AI issue or policy beyond a passing mention.
A mitigation commitment must identify an action aimed at an AI-related harm. General support for technological competitiveness does not meet that criterion.
I assess whether the observed event matched the forecast, not whether one event validates the speaker's probability judgment.
criteria.support_condition: The debate occurs, neither candidate discusses AI substantively, and neither commits to an action mitigating an AI harm.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Either candidate discusses AI substantively or makes an AI-harm mitigation commitment. If only one of the two predicted absences fails, assess the components separately.
